package domain

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	PracticeLearningRouteRequestSchemaV1  = "practice-learning-route-request.v1"
	PracticeLearningRouteSchemaV1         = "student-task-learning-snapshot.v1"
	PracticeMaterialEnsureRequestSchemaV1 = "practice-learning-material-ensure-request.v1"
	PracticeMaterialResultSchemaV1        = "practice-learning-material.v1"
	PracticeMaterialFingerprintVersion    = "practice-material-fingerprint-v1"
)

type LearningRequirementPolicy string

const (
	RequirementPolicyRequired    LearningRequirementPolicy = "required"
	RequirementPolicyRecommended LearningRequirementPolicy = "recommended"
	RequirementPolicyOptional    LearningRequirementPolicy = "optional"
	RequirementPolicyAdaptive    LearningRequirementPolicy = "adaptive"
)

type LearningRequirementDecision string

const (
	RequirementSatisfied        LearningRequirementDecision = "SATISFIED"
	RequirementLearn            LearningRequirementDecision = "LEARN"
	RequirementRecommend        LearningRequirementDecision = "RECOMMEND"
	RequirementOptional         LearningRequirementDecision = "OPTIONAL"
	RequirementChallengeOrLearn LearningRequirementDecision = "CHALLENGE_OR_LEARN"
)

type PracticeLearningRequirement struct {
	ID               string                    `json:"id"`
	Target           TargetRef                 `json:"target"`
	Policy           LearningRequirementPolicy `json:"policy"`
	MasteryThreshold float64                   `json:"mastery_threshold"`
}

type PracticeLearningStepInput struct {
	StepID       string                        `json:"step_id"`
	Requirements []PracticeLearningRequirement `json:"requirements"`
}

type PracticeLearningRouteRequestV1 struct {
	Schema             string                      `json:"schema"`
	StudentID          string                      `json:"student_id"`
	TaskInstanceID     string                      `json:"task_instance_id"`
	TaskRevisionID     string                      `json:"task_revision_id"`
	TaskRevisionDigest string                      `json:"task_revision_digest"`
	Locale             string                      `json:"locale"`
	Steps              []PracticeLearningStepInput `json:"steps"`
}

type LearningMaterialRef struct {
	Key                string                `json:"key"`
	GenerationKey      string                `json:"generation_key"`
	FingerprintVersion string                `json:"fingerprint_version"`
	Target             TargetRef             `json:"target"`
	Locale             string                `json:"locale"`
	PlannerVersion     string                `json:"planner_version"`
	PedagogyProfile    string                `json:"pedagogy_profile"`
	PresentationStyle  string                `json:"presentation_style"`
	GenerationPolicy   string                `json:"generation_policy"`
	PedagogyStrategies []PedagogyStrategyRef `json:"pedagogy_strategies"`
}

type ResolvedLearningRequirement struct {
	ID                   string                      `json:"id"`
	Target               TargetRef                   `json:"target"`
	Policy               LearningRequirementPolicy   `json:"policy"`
	MasteryThreshold     float64                     `json:"mastery_threshold"`
	Decision             LearningRequirementDecision `json:"decision"`
	DecisionReason       string                      `json:"decision_reason"`
	MasteryPolicyVersion string                      `json:"mastery_policy_version"`
	Blocking             bool                        `json:"blocking"`
	ChallengeOutAllowed  bool                        `json:"challenge_out_allowed"`
	Material             *LearningMaterialRef        `json:"material,omitempty"`
}

type PracticeLearningRouteStep struct {
	StepID       string                        `json:"step_id"`
	Ready        bool                          `json:"ready"`
	Requirements []ResolvedLearningRequirement `json:"requirements"`
}

type PracticeLearningRoute struct {
	Schema             string                      `json:"schema"`
	ID                 string                      `json:"id"`
	TaskInstanceID     string                      `json:"task_instance_id"`
	TaskRevisionID     string                      `json:"task_revision_id"`
	TaskRevisionDigest string                      `json:"task_revision_digest"`
	StudentID          string                      `json:"student_id"`
	Locale             string                      `json:"locale"`
	PlannerVersion     string                      `json:"planner_version"`
	RouteDigest        string                      `json:"route_digest"`
	Steps              []PracticeLearningRouteStep `json:"steps"`
	CreatedAt          time.Time                   `json:"created_at"`
}

type PracticeLearningRouteRecord struct {
	IdempotencyKey string
	RequestHash    string
	Route          PracticeLearningRoute
}

type LearningTargetDefinition struct {
	Ref           TargetRef   `json:"ref"`
	Title         string      `json:"title"`
	Description   string      `json:"description"`
	Prerequisites []TargetRef `json:"prerequisites"`
}

type PracticeMaterialEnsureRequestV1 struct {
	Schema      string `json:"schema"`
	RouteID     string `json:"route_id"`
	RouteDigest string `json:"route_digest"`
}

type PracticeMaterialResultV1 struct {
	Schema      string    `json:"schema"`
	MaterialKey string    `json:"material_key"`
	Target      TargetRef `json:"target"`
	CourseID    string    `json:"course_id"`
	LessonID    string    `json:"lesson_id"`
	Reused      bool      `json:"reused"`
}

var (
	practiceIDPattern     = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,127}$`)
	practiceLocalePattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z]{2}(?:-[a-z0-9]{2,8})?$`)
	practiceDigestPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)
)

func NormalizePracticeLearningRouteRequest(input PracticeLearningRouteRequestV1) (PracticeLearningRouteRequestV1, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.TaskInstanceID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskInstanceID)
	input.TaskRevisionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskRevisionID)
	input.TaskRevisionDigest = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskRevisionDigest))
	input.Locale = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.Locale))
	if input.Schema != PracticeLearningRouteRequestSchemaV1 || !validPracticeUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!validPracticeUUID(input.TaskInstanceID) || !validPracticeUUID(input.TaskRevisionID) ||
		!practiceDigestPattern.MatchString(input.TaskRevisionDigest) || !practiceLocalePattern.MatchString(input.Locale) ||
		len(input.Steps) == 0 || len(input.Steps) > 100 {
		return PracticeLearningRouteRequestV1{}, ErrValidation
	}
	stepIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(input.Steps))
	requirementIDs := make(map[string]struct{})
	requirementCount := 0
	for stepIndex := range input.Steps {
		step := &input.Steps[stepIndex]
		step.StepID = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(step.StepID))
		if !practiceIDPattern.MatchString(step.StepID) || len(step.Requirements) > 100 {
			return PracticeLearningRouteRequestV1{}, ErrValidation
		}
		if _, duplicate := stepIDs[step.StepID]; duplicate {
			return PracticeLearningRouteRequestV1{}, ErrValidation
		}
		stepIDs[step.StepID] = struct{}{}
		for requirementIndex := range step.Requirements {
			requirement := &step.Requirements[requirementIndex]
			requirement.ID = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(requirement.ID))
			target, err := NormalizeTargetRef(requirement.Target)
			if err != nil || !practiceIDPattern.MatchString(requirement.ID) ||
				requirement.MasteryThreshold <= 0 || requirement.MasteryThreshold > 1 ||
				!validLearningRequirementPolicy(requirement.Policy) {
				return PracticeLearningRouteRequestV1{}, ErrValidation
			}
			if _, duplicate := requirementIDs[requirement.ID]; duplicate {
				return PracticeLearningRouteRequestV1{}, ErrValidation
			}
			requirement.Target = target
			requirementIDs[requirement.ID] = struct{}{}
			requirementCount++
		}
	}
	if requirementCount == 0 || requirementCount > 500 {
		return PracticeLearningRouteRequestV1{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return input, nil
}

func validLearningRequirementPolicy(policy LearningRequirementPolicy) bool {
	switch policy {
	case RequirementPolicyRequired, RequirementPolicyRecommended, RequirementPolicyOptional, RequirementPolicyAdaptive:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func validPracticeUUID(value string) bool {
	if len(value) != 36 || value[8] != '-' || value[13] != '-' || value[18] != '-' || value[23] != '-' {
		return false
	}
	_, err := hex.DecodeString(strings.ReplaceAll(value, "-", ""))
	return err == nil
}
